title: Cut size bounded by edge count
statement: Let $G$ be a multigraph and let $C$ be a cut of $G$, given by a vertex subset $S$ that is nonempty and has nonempty complement. Then the size of $C$ — the number of edges of $G$ having exactly one endpoint in $S$, counted with multiplicity — is at most the total number of edges of $G$, again counted with multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: C is a cut of G (subset S with nonempty S and nonempty complement)
